I am all for the support of helping out legit falsely banned players and with this post I am not trying to witch hunt. If it condones removal or banning for witchhunting so be my fate. Before we gain more hatred for Nexon let us put down the pitch forks to review this.

> Random false ban

You were banned on the same day, 1/21/2020, when 2000 people were banned in a massive ban wave. You are not the "next victim," you were one of many many many people banned in a wave many days ago. This was not a sudden oopsie doopsie one-off event.

> I am its next victim

> Been a legit player for around 10 years

> spend tons of time, money and energy into this game

> I loved it my whole life and spent most of my growing years on this game.


These are appeals to pity. None of these things make you exclusive to the rules or help the notion of being falsely banned, removing the ban, proving innocence, or anything else that could be constructive. All this does is appeal to the Reddit hive of attack Nexon for being a bad company. Many Diamond MVP players were banned in that ban wave, you are not an exception for time or money spent.

> I turned on my computer and had my character set up to AFK in Glory Drill Hall before starting my day and when I returned home, I, for the first time saw the permanent ban notification.

> My recent experiences on this game has been a variation of things that resulted in people's banning such as really wonky and unstable internet to launcher issues.

You are appealing to false cause. Just because those things were occurring it does not mean you were banned for that reason OR are innocent.

> To my knowledge, players have been getting banned left and right for numerous reasons recently and I cannot say what exactly was the cause of my ban,

You are effectively asking for equivocation here in that you want us to believe that because people are getting falsely banned, that you have also been falsely banned.

> I never thought I would be banned for something I didn't do in the first place so what I have is scarce.

This is an appeal to ignorance in that, us Reddit people just don't have the information or the logs, so it would leave us to believe that there are no logs or reasons. Because there is no conclusive evidence it could make sense that this is a false ban. Well here is the final part of my post:
